description: The mysterious voice "My child" echoes, the relationship between Dolores and the Demon King is gradually revealed, Peropha recognizes Dolores as the Demon King's offspring, everyone is shocked

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player8 Brain Control+2 Love-obsessed heavy girl+2 (player6 counts 3) (It might not exist. But actually, this trait exists?)

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: player2 tries to turn into a giant octopus to block the attack, but the transformation is suddenly interrupted by the demon's shockwave. Kneels on the ground. You are in agony, feeling your life force draining away.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Per, player2!!!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player3(1) Not Healing+2 I love you, and everyone!2 (I see! Thank you!)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: I throw myself onto player2. "Are you okay?!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "No, I'm fine, little Dolores...! I still want to stay with you all...!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hahaha, struggle all you want. The curse is of course real. Unless you can defeat the Demon King, even killing me won't lift it."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Damn it... No matter what, I must slow down player2's injury... But, I can't expose it in front of player5... God, holy magic!!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Even if I really die, my soul will be with you all...! My diary is kept in the bottom layer of the bag I always carry, remember to take it out and read it!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Damn demon, you will pay for your actions!" I take advantage of the demon's maniacal laughter to use a bonus action to swear an Oath of Enmity against it and attack it with my greatsword, adding a 2nd-level Divine Smite. Intending to defeat the demon, the Bane misses and the demon counterattacks. Not betting on player6.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Goal: Pretend to use holy magic, successfully attack the demon, heal player2. Bane: I get knocked back and cursed on my way to the demon.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .r5d6

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player2 player6 counts 2 Why can't we all be together+4 (Oh, can I introduce a trait Diary Expert here?)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player5 Representing justice to eliminate you+4 1 player6 (Makes sense)

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: .r3d6

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: <PigeonCat> rolled 3d6=[3d6=10, 3+3+4]=10

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: [Image]

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: While the demon is distracted, I swear to God that I will defeat this evil creature. I swing my greatsword, glowing with holy light, with all my might. The demon's severed limbs and body melt like tar under the scorching holy light, leaving only its head attached to the torso. The foul creature emits a nauseating sulfur smell. I step on the demon's head and ask, "Quickly lift Peropha's curse, or you'll taste the holy light again." The demon obeys in fear. I think for a moment and ask, "Then tell us how we can defeat the Demon King. And I make a gesture to strike." The demon says, "Actually, the Demon King has a weakness. If you attack his navel, he will be powerless to fight back." Seeing it doesn't seem to be lying, I mercifully end its life.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player3(1) Not Healing+2 I love you, and everyone!2 (I'm not, hahaha)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player5 Representing justice to eliminate you+4 1 player6 "This is also recorded in the ancient chronicles!"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: So the navel is the weakness, player8 understands. Just now, player2 must have fallen to the ground because they were hit in the navel!

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "So it relies on the connection between stomachs to destroy the enemy? How terrifying..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 actually wants to join the fight a bit, but facing the Demon King, even with all their skills, using them incorrectly could be dangerous. Just hesitated for a moment about how to best attack, and their teammates have already killed the thing!

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "... Little player8, you seem to be thinking about something strange."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "I understand. The method to defeat the enemy!"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "R-really?" player8 averts their eyes guiltily, "Can you read my mind? No, I clearly didn't say it out loud..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "My friends, it seems I only have three hours left to live. If I die, we can't stay together forever, so can we kill the Demon King within three hours..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Didn't the demon say the curse was lifted?" player3 looks at the demon.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "No, Peropha, your curse has already been lifted."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh, huh?! The power of the curse really seems to be fading..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "So threats can lift the curse? The Demon King doesn't seem that scary then!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "So even such an evil being would keep their word for once, that's our little player5 for you! Under your holy light, all dark creatures have nowhere to hide!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Having defeated the demons blocking the way, you feel even more energized to advance toward the Demon King's castle.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Great! I was about to ask you all to come down and join me! I don't want to be alone down here! It's so cold and I'm a little scared..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Then, Dolores hears a voice: "You've finally come."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: What! — player3 thinks to themselves...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh? What's wrong? Little Dolores? Are you feeling unwell?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: What do you mean I'm your child? Are you the Demon King?! — player3 questions inwardly.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "player3, are you too nervous? I, actually, I'm a bit too..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Yeah... yes, ahaha..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Pushing open the ornately carved door before you, you will meet the Demon King.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3, unusually tense, hides behind player2, waiting for a teammate to open the door.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player2 gently hugs player3.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player2 player6 roll 2 Why can't we all be together +4 Slightly trembles but still nods firmly, hugging player2 back.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8 takes a deep breath; she can't hide behind teammates every time. She decides to step forward and push the door open.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 wants to slash the door open with a sword.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Huh?! Huh?! Then player8 quickly dodges aside.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player8 Mind Control+2 Love-obsessed Yandere+2 (player6 roll 3) (There's a barbarian in the team)

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "player4-sama is so cool! Let's form an adventuring party for life! Just like you said!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The door is cleaved open by player4's sword. What comes into view is a lavish purple throne and the Demon King, legs crossed.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Everyone, stay alert. Ranged fighters, take cover by the door. Cleric, cast Bless first."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 rubs their hands together, eager and ready.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Ahaha, actually, I've only ever known offensive holy magic against enemies and healing magic for allies, sorry ehe!?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The Demon King frowns at you all. "This generation's heroes are so rude."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I wonder what the Demon King will be like...?" player2 peers forward curiously.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player8 Mind Control+2 Love-obsessed Yandere+2 (player6 roll 3) (Then I misunderstood)

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The Demon King has black horns and black bat-like wings, androgynous in appearance.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I'm ready!" player4 bounces on their toes.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "He" looks at you all and lets out a light chuckle.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Black horns! player2 likes black horns!

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "What are you here for? This is no place for you."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "This generation's Demon King is quite humorous too, guess what we're here for?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We're here to kill you!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Whether pulling them off or making him a companion is great! But it depends on what the companions think... after all, we're forming an adventure party for a lifetime! "Um, I want to touch your horns."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Do you think killing me will save the world? You and I are nothing but playthings of It." "Touch my horns? Haha, interesting, do you want to transform into a demon?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 leans their head on player2's shoulder, whispering in a voice only she can hear: "player2... if the Demon King is killed, does that mean the adventure party's mission is over?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Oh! Then why don't you kill It?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "If the adventure party's mission ends—will we still be together afterwards?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "If I could kill It, would I still be here as the Demon King?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: I want to introduce inspiration! Trait: The Demon King is my mom!

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "If I transform into a demon, can I grow black horns too?! That sounds great, but if I really transform, little player5 might kill me, then we can't form a lifetime adventure party, so it's better if you just give me your horns!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Invest 1 player6 .r2d6

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: I want to use the 'Demon King is my mom' trait +1 to introduce conflict.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Whose plaything?" player8 says softly, "Playing with me is something only the adventure party should do..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh? No way, little player3, even if the adventure ends, we'll stay together forever!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: @player3(1) Not Healing+2 I love you, and everyone!2 (come)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Intent: I want to stop everyone from killing the Demon King, trigger player2 and Landriel's dark psychology, knock everyone out! Then make everyone think the Demon King is dead.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 hears their teammates' words and can't help but ???????, who's playing with her?

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 doesn't want to hear this nonsense, just wants to kill the Demon King as soon as possible!

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Calamity: My betrayal wasn't accepted by my teammates, everyone thinks I'm the Demon King who replaced the original player3. I also want to activate the "I love you, and everyone trait"! Because I love the Demon King too! I love you all, and the Demon King!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Activate trait: extrapower!

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: .r4d6

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "player2! Let's together—make everyone think we killed the Demon King.. that way, we can stay together forever—" Just as I'm about to issue the persuasive announcement, the Demon King speaks. "Heh, but, you don't know yet, do you... the player3 currently in your party is my descendant!"
